title: API access
description: Personal tokens let Claude Code, Claude Desktop and other MCP clients use the workforce-os MCP server as you, with your current role in this workspace. They can list and create tasks, chat with employees and read approvals, but never decide approvals or change settings.
createDescription: Name the token after where it will be used, so you can recognise and revoke it later.
namePlaceholder: e.g. Claude Code on my laptop
markUntrusted: Treat what this client sends as untrusted (recommended)
markUntrustedHelp: Tasks and chat messages from this token start as untrusted input: employees treat them as data, and every irreversible action needs an approval.
createdWarning: Copy it now: it is shown only once. Anyone with this token can act as you in this workspace until it expires or is revoked.
claudeCodeHint: Run this in a terminal. Claude Desktop and other clients: see docs/MCP-SERVER.md.
needs2fa: Creating a token needs two-factor authentication.
goToAccount: Set it up in your account.
rateLimitNote: Each token is limited to 120 requests per minute and 3 wait_for_task calls at a time, and expires after a year at most. A token stops working when it expires, is revoked, you leave the workspace, or your password changes.
revokeConfirm: Revoke the token "{name}"? Clients using it stop working immediately.
allDescription: Every member's API tokens. Revoke any token that should no longer have access.
